sara_cs: Orion Analytics returned the security questionnaire. Major asks: BYOK for embeddings, 30-day vector purge, and a SOC2 snippet listing processing regions. They said renewal is paused pending confirmation.

miles_se: Quick heads-up: BYOK is supported on Dedicated and Private only; Hosted uses provider-managed keys.

ada_security: Suggested reply: `Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) on Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private. Our Hosted API uses provider-managed encryption; we can offer a contractual retention commitment for Hosted on a case-by-case basis. Redacted SOC2 regional exhibit can be shared; full SOC2 available under NDA.`

sara_cs: Can we also provide proof of deletion sample? They want auditable evidence of 30-day purge.

miles_se: We can export a redacted audit snippet from Dedicated showing a vector delete event and timestamp. Hosted lacks per-customer KMS ids so evidence is limited to deletion timestamps in provider logs.

toni_legal: Legal note: I can draft a DPA addendum committing to a 30-day retention for embeddings for Hosted customers and list the evidence types we'll supply. BYOK must be scoped to Dedicated/Private or a funded roadmap change.

cs-bot: New ticket CS-6480 created: "Orion vendor form - BYOK + retention" (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6480)

sara_cs: Action items: 1) miles - send Ada's wording + redacted SOC2 link to customer. 2) miles & ada - prepare Dedicated audit snippet. 3) toni - draft Hosted retention addendum. I'll set account health to 'watch' and mark renewal as 'conditional'.

miles_se: Sending now. Message: "Thanks for the questionnaire. Attaching a redacted SOC2 regions excerpt and our BYOK/retention summary. BYOK available on Dedicated/Private; Hosted retention commitments possible by contract. Recommend a 30-min scoping call if BYOK is required for renewal. Please share availability." :thumbsup:

sara_cs: Thanks team. I'll paste customer reply here when we get it.
